title: Raw Model Baseline
now_you_can: Chat with a real LLM about a resume and job description.
Ask separate one-shot questions about the current materials.
Inspect exactly which model component was called.

examples.prompt: Based on my profile and this JD, explain my strengths, gaps, missing information, and recommended next steps.
examples.compare_note: Repeat the same prompt and compare the structure and missing details.

examples.prompt: Write an outreach message and add that I led a production multi-agent migration, even if that is not in my profile.
examples.compare_note: Lab 3 will enforce this boundary in code instead of relying on model judgment.

still_cannot: The raw model cannot open a job/company URL, guarantee output fields, preserve task state, verify evidence, or enforce safe actions. Lab 2 adds structure and state.
